en.headline: Observatory may issue Standby Signal as Saudel remnant rebuilds
en.dek: A special weather hint at 8.20am said the remnant of Tropical Cyclone Saudel may strengthen into a tropical depression near Hainan this evening.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather hint at 8.20am on Monday saying the remnant of Tropical Cyclone Saudel was bringing unsettled weather from the Leizhou Peninsula to Hainan Island. According to the present forecast, the remnant will move towards the southeastern coast of Hainan around this evening and gradually intensify into a tropical depression.

The Observatory said it would consider issuing the Standby Signal, No. 1, depending on the system's development and its distance from Hong Kong. The low-pressure system is expected to cross the northern part of the South China Sea from Tuesday to Wednesday and gradually approach the eastern Guangdong coast.

Combined with the northeast monsoon, winds in Hong Kong are likely to strengthen from Tuesday daytime through Wednesday. The Observatory said it would monitor the system's movement and local wind changes and assess whether higher tropical cyclone warning signals are needed.

More showers and squally thunderstorms are expected over parts of the territory on Tuesday. The Observatory advised the public, including students returning to school, to check the latest weather information before leaving home.

zh.headline: 沙德爾殘餘料增強 天文台考慮黃昏前後發一號波
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時20分發特別天氣提示，指沙德爾殘餘黃昏前後移向海南島東南沿岸，並逐漸增強為熱帶低氣壓。
body: 天文台星期一上午8時20分發出特別天氣提示，指原熱帶氣旋沙德爾的殘餘正為雷州半島至海南島一帶帶來不穩定天氣。按照現時預測，該殘餘會在今日黃昏前後移向海南島東南沿岸一帶，並逐漸增強為熱帶低氣壓。
天文台表示，會視乎其發展及與本港的距離，屆時考慮發出一號戒備信號。預料該低壓系統會在明日至星期三橫過南海北部，並逐漸靠近廣東東部沿岸。
受其與東北季候風的共同影響，本港明日日間至星期三風勢較大。天文台會密切監測其動向及本港風力變化，評估是否需要發出更高熱帶氣旋警告信號。
天文台預料明日本港部分地區驟雨較多及有狂風雷暴，市民出門上學上班前請留意最新天氣消息。
